name: Club de Polo y Equitacion San Cristobal S.A.
summary: Club de Polo y Equitación San Cristóbal S.A. operates sports club in Chile. The company's facilities include polo, horse riding, golf, tennis, football, and gym/spa, as well as restaurants. Club de Polo y Equitación San Cristóbal S.A. was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Vitacura, Chile.
